items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Mallory was a trumpet player in the band. And Charlie Turner, bass player.

ctx.x: And so I joined Hardy, it must've been oh, let me see now. I joined Hardy's band -- I think I went to Chicago to join that band. Cause that was their headquarters. And they worked out of Chicago. Eddie Mallory was a trumpet player in the band. And Charlie Turner, bass player. That's right, I went to Chicago and joined that band. And their headquarters out of Chicago. We did one-night stands all over everywhere, Iowa and Chicago, jumping out of cars and I stayed with that band until I got an offer to go to the…
Now that must've been very exciting.
